name: Shiori
message: "Ah, Mary-san's payphone."

name: Shiori
message: "She's one of the biggest names in urban legend circles... She's basically a celebrity, right? A celebrity aberration?"

name: Shiori
message: "You know, it's probably even rarer than running into a celebrity. I wonder how many people in the world have actually met Mary-san."

name: Shiori
message: "And then there's me, who took a full-force swing at her with an axe."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't believe I survived that."

name: Shiori
message: "Actually... now that I think about it, I do feel kind of guilty. I was rather awful to Mary-san..."

name: Shiori
message: "...No, wait. She tried to kill you. There's no reason for me to feel guilty, then."

name: Shiori
message: "...Yeah, but I'm the one who summoned her out of curiosity... so doesn't that make it my fault?"

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe I'll just drop it. There's no point going in circles like this."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, it just occurred to me... I seem to think of the axe as my main weapon."

name: Shiori
message: "Even back when I snapped at the supermarket lady, I pulled one out like it was the most natural thing in the world."

name: Shiori
message: "At first, I was only testing whether I could turn the rope into something else, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Why an axe?"

name: Shiori
message: "Couldn't it have been something else, like... ah, a katana!"

name: Shiori
message: "A sailor uniform and a katana are kind of a classic combo, right? Looks really cool, too."

name: Shiori
message: "I should've gone with a katana... It's definitely better than an axe. Why did I have to pick an axe of all things?"

name: Shiori
message: "I can't believe how depressed I'm getting over this... I want to go back in time and slap myself for getting all excited about cracking someone's skull with an axe..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Let's just go. Staying here is only going to drag me down even further. I might end up losing my memories, or worse, even my sense of self..."
